ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  3B BlackBio Dx Limited (formerly Kilpest India Limited) has announced its 54th Annual General Meeting for September 29, 2026, providing crucial dates for the dividend payment for FY 2025-26 and shareholder e-voting. Shareholders must note the September 22, 2026 record date to be eligible for the dividend, with payments commencing on or after October 5, 2026, and share transfer books closing from September 23-29, 2026. This is a standard regulatory disclosure compliant with SEBI LODR, providing essential operational information to investors without presenting any immediate red flags.
